messages:
ranjit-fin: Looping folks in — customer Skylark disputed their March invoice, saying ~720k embeds were billed twice. They attached sample request_ids and SDK logs. Can eng/data triage?

kevin-eng: thanks. can you drop org_id and sample? I saw a note about a partner SDK release last week.

anna-cs: org_id=skylark-main, CSV uploaded to secure drive and shared w/kevin. customer asking for provisional credit while we investigate.

maria-data: quick headcount on embed_events for skylark-main between 2026-03-10T10:00 and 2026-03-10T12:30 UTC: raw_rows=1,820,742 distinct_by(request_id, ack_id)=1,100,231 => estimated duplicates ~720,511.

kevin-eng: I pulled edge-proxy logs and partner-sdk logs. Interesting: partner-sdk v3.4 shipped a change that duplicated the X-Client-Request header on retry, which maps to our dedupe key. So retries generated identical dedupe keys but were sent twice because the SDK re-sent an already-acked payload. snippet from vendor logs: "attempt=1 err=timeout, header=X-Req:xyz; attempt=2 header=X-Req:xyz"

vendor-sdk-bot: Vendor SDK team acknowledged a bug in v3.4 that can cause duplicate header copies on retry. Issue VS-991 opened. Patch expected in next patch release.

kevin-eng: root cause is client-side header duplication combined with our ingest path writing before de-dupe. This looks different from proxy 5xx bursts. Duplicates are real ingests. We can run a dedupe+replay to get canonical counts. Risk: losing legitimately retried payloads where first attempt truly failed. But vendor logs suggest most were successful then retried.

ranjit-fin: propose provisional credit $792 (round up) while data runs full recount and we await vendor patch. This is based on billing rate $0.0011/embed * 720,511 ~= $792.56. Approve?

anna-cs: customer wants clear next steps and timeline. I'll tell them provisional credit issued and we'll reconcile within 5 business days after replay.

billing-bot: Created provisional credit ticket FIN-2519 for $792 tied to skylark-main period=2026-03-10 reason="sdk header-dup duplicate embeds" status=pending-approval.

maria-data: starting full dedupe+replay job now. ETA ~6h because we need to re-derive dedupe keys and re-ingest unique events. Will post final distinct counts and reconciliation delta when done.

ranjit-fin: approved provisional credit. Keep me posted. If vendor issues refund\/credits for their customers we can consider clawback later.

kevin-eng: follow-up: will add mitigations — move dedupe earlier in pipeline and add an ingest-time idempotency check for high-volume partners. Logging a follow-up engineering ticket ENG-6723.

anna-cs: replied to customer: "We've issued a provisional credit while we run a full recount. We'll update with final numbers within 5 business days." customer replied :thanks:"
